## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost (16/3)

## How it works

- [statement] The current Atlas configuration page says converting a replica set to a sharded cluster produces dedicated config servers even when Atlas management is enabled. Customers requiring embedded config servers after conversion are directed to MongoDB Support. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The Atlas settings HTML retrieved on October 30 describes embedded config servers for new Atlas-managed sharded clusters with ten or fewer shards and dedicated config servers above ten; shard-count changes trigger re-selection. This is a documentation statement with a conflicting five-shard threshold elsewhere, not a resolved universal limit. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/config-shard.md
- [statement] Verify topology with sh.isConfigShardEnabled() or listShards and an entry whose _id is config. Atlas warns that replica-set IDs containing config or shard do not reliably indicate the stored data, so names alone cannot confirm the cost-saving topology. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/config-shard.md · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Config shards reduce infrastructure overhead by combining roles in a replica set instead of maintaining an additional dedicated config-server replica set. The cited sources support a qualitative saving, not a universal Atlas dollar or percentage discount. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/config-shard.md · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/, https://www.percona.com/blog/scaling-smarter-what-you-have-missed-in-mongodb-8-0/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB 8.0 introduced config shards, which store application data and cluster metadata together. Combining these roles avoids a separate dedicated config-server replica set and reduces infrastructure overhead. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/config-shard.md, https://www.percona.com/blog/scaling-smarter-what-you-have-missed-in-mongodb-8-0/
- [statement] Percona argues that consolidation benefits small clusters most; for large clusters, relative savings are minor and distinct replica-set roles improve maintenance. This is qualitative architectural guidance, not a measured Atlas savings percentage. (low confidence) — https://www.percona.com/blog/scaling-smarter-what-you-have-missed-in-mongodb-8-0/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost
- [statement] Atlas documents management as enabled by default for MongoDB 8.0 sharded clusters. Disabling management selects dedicated config servers. Upgrading an existing cluster from 7.0 to 8.0 enables management without changing its existing config-server type. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings.md
- [statement] Dedicated Atlas config servers use a separate three-node replica set. Billing documentation specifies a separate config-node rate reflected in cluster cost; application cluster-tier and data-storage selections do not determine config-node cost. Do not estimate that charge as another application shard at the same price. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/
- [statement] Atlas documents transition restrictions involving time-series data, Queryable Encryption and MongoDB Search indexes; it also says embedded config servers are unsupported on Global Clusters. These restrictions scope whether the lower-resource topology is available. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings.md
- [statement] The MongoDB manual says config shards have no measurable performance impact at low shard counts, but this page supplies no benchmark. It identifies Queryable Encryption collections and on-premises queryable backups as features requiring dedicated config-server isolation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/config-shard.md · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost
- [statement] CloudPirates exposes shardedCluster.configsvr.enableConfigShard, default false, to let MongoDB 8.0+ config servers store user data through transitionFromDedicatedConfigServer. This is independent implementation evidence for the combined role, not evidence of an Atlas billing rate. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CloudPirates-io/helm-charts/main/charts/mongodb/README.md · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost
- [statement] Atlas requires snapshots from dedicated-config clusters to restore to dedicated-config clusters, and embedded-config snapshots to restore to embedded-config clusters. Cost-driven topology changes therefore need restore-compatibility planning. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings.md
- [statement] For dedicated config servers, Atlas documents a three-node replica set on M30 tiers. Its billing documentation says config nodes have a separate rate, included in cluster cost, unaffected by the selected data-node tier and storage settings. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/
- [statement] Turning Atlas-managed config servers off on an embedded-config cluster with fewer than eleven shards immediately transitions it to dedicated config servers according to the October 30 Atlas settings page; this changes the resource topology that underlies the cost comparison. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost
- [statement] The October 30 Atlas settings page says upgrading an existing sharded cluster from MongoDB 7.0 to 8.0 enables Atlas-managed config servers without changing its existing config-server type. An upgrade alone therefore does not establish that the cluster received embedded-config cost savings. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cluster-additional-settings/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost
- [statement] Atlas lists configuration-server replica-set storage among Cloud Backup charges for sharded deployments. A dedicated-config cost comparison should therefore consider applicable backup storage as well as config-node compute charges; the page does not quantify the saving from switching topology. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Config shard versus dedicated config server cost
